mn123:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn123:2.1: Atha kho sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam antarākathā udapādi:--
mn123:2.2: Acchariyaṃ, āvuso, abbhutaṃ, āvuso, Tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā,
mn123:2.3: yatra hi nāma Tathāgato atīte Buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jānissati:
mn123:2.4: Evaṃ-jaccā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi, evaṃnāmā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi, evaṃ-gottā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi, evaṃ-sīlā . . . evaṃ-dhammā . . . evaṃ-paññā . . . evaṃ-vihārī . . . evaṃ-vimuttā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pīti.
mn123:2.5: Evaṃ vutte, āyasmā Ānando te bhikkhū etad avoca:--
mn123:2.6: Acchariyā c' eva, āvuso, Tathāgatā acchariyadhammasamannāgatā ca;
mn123:2.7: abbhutā c' eva, āvuso, Tathāgatā abbhutadhammasamannāgatā cāti.
mn123:2.8: Ayañ ca h' idan tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ antarākathā vippakatā hoti.
mn123:2.9: Atha Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yen' upaṭṭhānasālā ten' upasaṃkami upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn123:2.11: Kāya nu 'ttha, bhikkhave, etarahi kathāya sannisinnā? Kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatā ti?
mn123:2.12: Idha, bhante, amhākaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam antarākathā udapādi:
mn123:2.13: Acchariyaṃ, āvuso, . . . (etc. as above, down to) . . . evaṃ-vimuttā
mn123:2.14: te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pīti. Evaṃ vutte, bhante, āyasmā Ānando amhe etad avoca:
mn123:2.17: Ayaṃ kho no, bhante, antarākathā vippakatā. Atha Bhagavā anuppatto ti.
mn123:2.18: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:-Tasmātiha
mn123:2.19: taṃ, Ānanda, bhiyyosomattāya paṭibhantu Tathāgatassa acchariyā abbhutadhammā ti.
mn123:3.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:
mn123:3.2: Sato sampajāno uppajjamāno, Ānanda, Bodhisatto Tusitaṃ kāyaṃ uppajjīti;
mn123:3.3: yam pi, bhante, sato sampajāno Bodhisatto Tusitaṃ kāyaṃ uppajji, idam ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:4.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ;
mn123:4.2: Sato sampajāno, Ānanda, Bodhisatto Tusite kāye aṭṭhāsīti;
mn123:4.3: yam pi, bhante, sato sampajano Bodhisatto Tusite kāye aṭṭhāsi, idam p' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:5.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:5.2: Yāvatāyukaṃ, Ānanda, Bodhisatto Tusite kāye aṭṭhāsīti;
mn123:5.3: yam pi, bhante, yāvatāyukaṃ Bodhisatto Tusite kāye aṭṭhāsi, idam p' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:6.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:6.2: Sato sampajāno, Ānanda, Bodhisatto Tusitā kāyā cavitvā mātu kucchiṃ okkamīti;
mn123:6.3: yam pi, bhante, sato sampajāno Bodhisatto Tusitā kāyā cavitvā mātu kucchiṃ okkami, idam p' ahaṃ Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:7.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sataṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:7.2: Yadā, Ānanda, Bodhisatto Tusitā kāyā cavitvā mātu kucchiṃ okkami,
mn123:7.3: atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo uḷaro obhāso pātubhavati atikkamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
mn123:7.4: Yā pi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā, yattha p' ime candimasuriyā evaṃ-mahiddhikā evaṃ-mahānubhāvā ābhāya nānubhonti, tattha pi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ;
mn123:7.5: ye pi tattha sattā upapannā, te pi ten' obhāsena aññamannaṃ sañjānanti: Aññe pi kira bho santi sattā idh' upapannā.
mn123:7.6: Ayañ ca dasasahassīlokadhātu saṃkampati sampakampati sampavedhati, appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvan ti.
mn123:7.7: Yam pi, bhante, . . . idaṃ p' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:8.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammakhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:8.2: Yadā, Ānanda, Bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti, cattāro nan devaputtā catuddisārakkhāya upagacchanti: Mā naṃ kho Bodhisattaṃ vā Bodhisattamātaraṃ va manusso vā amanusso vā koci vā viheṭhesīti.
mn123:8.3: Yam pi, bhante, . . . idam; p' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:9.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammakhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:9.2: Yadā, Ānanda, Bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti, pakatiyā sīlavatī Bodhisattamātā hoti, viratā pāṇātipātā viratā adinnādānā viratā kāmesu micchācārā viratā musāvādā viratā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā ti.
mn123:9.3: Yam pi, bhante, . . . idam; ' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:10.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:10.2: Yadā, Ānanda, Bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti, na Bodhisattamātu purisesu mānasaṃ uppajjati kāmaguṇūpasaṃhitaṃ, anatikkamanīyā ca Bodhisattamātā hoti kenaci purisena rattacittenāti.
mn123:10.3: Yam pi, bhante, . . . idam p' ahaṃ, bhante,acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:11.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:11.2: Yadā, Ānanda, Bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti, lābhinā Bodhisattamātā hoti pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ, sa pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgibhūtā parivāretīti.
mn123:11.3: Yam pi, bhante . . . idam p' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:12.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭigghītaṃ:--
mn123:12.2: Yadā, Ānanda, Bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti, na Bodhisattamātu kocid eva ābādho uppajjati, sukhinī Bodhisattamātā hoti akilantakāyā, Bodhisattañ ca Bodhisattamātā tirokucchigataṃ passati sabbaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ abhinindriyaṃ.
mn123:12.3: Seyyathāpi, Ānanda, maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato; tatr' assa suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā;
mn123:12.4: taṃ enaṃ cakkhumā puriso hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya: Ayaṃ kho maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato, tatr' idaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pīta. vā lahitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā ti;--
mn123:12.5: evam eva kho, Ānanda, yadā Bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti, na Bodhisattamātu kocid eva ābādho uppajjati, sukhinī sattamātā tirokucchigataṃ passati sabbaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ abhinindriyaṃ.
mn123:12.6: Yam pi, bhante, . . . idam p' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:13.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:13.2: Sattāhajāte, Ānanda, Bodhisatte Bodhisattamātā kālaṃ karoti, Tusitaṃ kāyaṃ uppajjatīti.
mn123:13.3: Yam pi, bhante, . . . idam p' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi
mn123:14.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:14.2: Yathā kho pan', Ānanda aññā itthikā nava vā dasa vā māse gabbhaṃ kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyanti, na h' evaṃ Bodhisattaṃ Bodhisattamātā vijāyati; das' eva māsāni Bodhisattaṃ Bodhisattamātā kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyatīti.
mn123:14.3: Yam pi, bhante, . . . idam p' ahaṃ, bhante, acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:15.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:15.2: Yathā kho pan', Ānanda, aññā itthikā nisinnā vā nipannā vā vijāyanti, na h' evaṃ Bodhisattaṃ Bodhisattamātā vijāyati; ṭhitā va Bodhisattaṃ Bodhisattamātā vijāyatīti.
mn123:15.3: Yam pi, bhante, . . . idam p' ahaṃ, bhante, acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:16.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:16.2: Yadā, Ānanda, Bodhisatto mātu kucchismā nikkhamati, devā paṭhamaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti pacchā manussā ti.
mn123:16.3: Yam pi, bhante, . . . idam p' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:17.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:17.2: Yadā, Ānanda, Bodhisatto mātu kucchismā nikkhamati, appatto va Bodhisatto paṭhaviṃ hoti; cattāro nan devaputtā paṭiggahetvā mātu purato ṭhapenti: Attamanā devī hohi, mahesakkho te putto upapanno ti.
mn123:17.3: Yam pi, bhante, . . . idam p' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:18.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:18.2: Yadā, Ānanda, Bodhisatto mātu kucchismā nikkhamati, visado va nikkhamati amakkhito uddena amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho visado.
mn123:18.3: Seyyathāpi, Ānanda, maṇiratanaṃ kāsike vatthe nikkhittaṃ, n' eva maṇiratanaṃ kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ makkheti nāpi kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ maṇiratanaṃ makkheti;--
mn123:18.6: evam eva kho, Ānanda, yadā Bodhisatto mātu kucchismā nikkhamati, visado va nikkhamati amakkhito uddena amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito kenaci asucinā suddho visado ti.
mn123:18.7: Yam pi, bhante, . . . idam p' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:19.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:19.2: Yadā, Ānanda, Bodhisatto mātu kucchismā nikkhamati, dve udakassa dhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti, ekā sītassa ekā uṇhassa, yena Bodhisattassa udakakiccaṃ karonti mātucāti.
mn123:19.3: Yam pi, bhante, . . . idam p' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:20.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:20.2: Sampatijāto, Ānanda, Bodhisatto samehi pādehi paṭiṭṭhahitvā uttarābhimukho sattapadavītihāre gacchati, setamhi chatte anubhiramāne sabbā ca disā viloketi, āsabhiñ ca vācaṃ bhāsati; Aggo 'ham asmi lokassa, seṭṭho 'ham asmi lokassa, jeṭṭho 'ham asmi lokassa, ayam antimā jāti, na 'tthi dāni punabbhavo ti.
mn123:20.3: Yam pi, bhante, . . . idam p' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremi.
mn123:21.1: Sammukhā me taṃ, bhante, Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:--
mn123:21.2: Yadā, Ānanda, Bodhisatto mātu kucchismā nikkhamati, atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo uḷaro obhāso pātubhavati atikamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ;
mn123:21.3: yā pi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakāra andhakāratimisā, yatthā p' ime candimasuriyā evaṃ mahiddhikā evaṃ mahānubhāvā ābhāya nānubhonti, tattha pi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ;
mn123:21.4: ye pi tattha sattā upapannā te pi ten' obhāsena aññamaññaṃ sañjānanti: Aññe pi kira bho santi sattā idhūpapannā ti. Ayam pi
mn123:21.5: ca dasasahassīlokadhātu saṃkampati sampakampati sampavedhati appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvan ti.
mn123:21.6: Yam pi, bhante, . . . idam p' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremīti.
mn123:22.1: Tasmātiha tvaṃ, Ānanda, idam pi Tathāgatassa acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhārehi.
mn123:22.2: Idh', Ānanda, Tathāgatassa viditā vedanā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti;
mn123:22.4: viditā vitakkā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
mn123:22.5: Idam pi kho tvaṃ, Ānanda, Tathāgatassa acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhārehīti.
mn123:23.1: Yam pi, bhante, Bhagavato viditā vedanā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti;
mn123:23.3: viditā vitakkā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti, --
mn123:23.4: idam p' ahaṃ, bhante, Bhagavato acchariyaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ dhāremīti.
mn123:23.7: Attamanā te bhikkhū āyasmato Ānandassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandun
